runs.name: KION GROUP AG
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **EUR 33.85** (Xetra close 2026-10-12, Yahoo `KGX.DE`, aggregator, flagged; ADR KIGRY USD 9.35, one ADR = one-fourth of a share per the depositary's F-6 POS of 2017-09-18, acc 0001193805-17-002687, an unsponsored programme). Shares **131,124,771** (131,198,647 issued less 73,876 treasury, Q2 2026 interim report; one class); cap **EUR 4,438.6M**. Sovereign **3.78%** (EUR; ECB AAA curve 30-year spot, YC.B.U2.EUR.4F.G_N_A.SV_C_YM.SR_30Y, 2026-10-09). Not an SEC filer: documents read in place of accession numbers, the annual reports 2025 (published 2026-02-26), 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2019, 2018 and 2017 (English; the German is authoritative) and the Q2 2026 interim report (2026-07-30); 2020 from the 2021 report's comparatives; one figure cross-checked (net financial debt EUR 584.0M at 2025-12-31 in the multi-year overview equals financial liabilities less cash on the statement). `tools/run.py` and `Screens/cover_shares.py` returned not an SEC filer; all arithmetic by hand. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report's group fundamentals, risk report and report on the economic position, as the overnight brief directs. Competitors: no rival is named in any of the eight annual reports; none compared; flagged. **Q1 IN**: Industrial Trucks & Services (forklifts and warehouse trucks with service, rental and a captive leasing arm) is 83% of five-year segment adjusted EBIT and decides; 92.6% of 2025 orders electric, service 50.9% of segment revenue; Supply Chain Solutions (Dematic, renamed Intelligent Automation Solutions from 2026) does not decide. **Q2 OUT**: a standing but contested castle (EMEA unit leader, world number two, premium brands, installed-base service) that has protected only ordinary returns over 2017-2025 on the filer's own figures: group ROCE never above 9.7% pre-tax (2.9% in 2022); owner cash about 5% of tangible capital over 2021-25 (10.7% to 11.1% in the two best years); global unit share 15.0% (2016) to about 13%, no longer given from 2023; ITS margin 11.3% (2016) to 8.7% (2025); 2022 price rises "did little to compensate" until the next year; the risk report names rivals with "cost advantages" and "fierce" price competition in the economy and volume segments. Q3 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, recorded not weighed: ten balance sheets 2016-2025 (EUR 1.84bn of the EUR 3.6bn rise in equity from new shares, at EUR 64.83 in 2017 and EUR 62.04 in 2020; goodwill and intangibles over equity by EUR 3.7bn in 2016, equity over them by EUR 0.65bn in 2025; the leasing book EUR 1.16bn to 4.86bn, almost entirely debt-funded; inventories 10.0% to 14.4% of revenue; net financial debt EUR 2.9bn to 0.58bn, then 1.24bn at 2026-06-30); non-recurring charges every year (EUR 201M in 2025); a 2026 redefinition of free cash flow that added EUR 494.7M to the first half; no buyback; Weichai Power and affiliates hold 46.5%, EUR 100.2M of purchases from them in 2025; Executive Board pay EUR 26.1M in 2025 (16.6M in 2024); integrity facts recorded, not judged. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after every real cost EUR 221.5M a year all-equity (2021-25; equity-only EUR 175.9M), negative in 2020 and 2022; range **EUR 7.01 to 67.26 a share** (all-equity, less net financial debt EUR 1,244.1M; bottom the 2018-25 cycle base declining 12.9% a year, top the window maintenance-only at no growth) against EUR 33.85, literal window EUR 35.20 beside; floor tested first: no case earns about ten percent at the price (best 9.5%, a case that double-credits growth); fair price beneath the stop **EUR 9.10 all-equity** (ADR EUR 2.27), EUR 16.09 equity-only; not armed (box not OUT at Q7). A CONVENTION of the run treats the lease-business and rental liabilities (EUR 5.3bn) as the finance arm's own funding, not net debt, because operating cash flow already charges that business's fleet growth and interest; counted as debt the fair price is negative (EUR -31.44). A robotics stake signed 2026-07-20 ("low-triple-digit millions", not closed) shown beside only. Contamination declared by the analyst: another company's run (JCSE) in session-context commit subjects; none used. Commits 5511237d, d59006fb, 49906996, f5d1cd5a. Citations: the analyst's check PASS (36 ids); the dispatcher's script (`dispatcher_cite_check.py`) 36 distinct ids resolved, 0 E-ids, every ledger quote found in its row (the script's unmatched items were filing quotes and markdown bold, checked by hand), 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) Q2's ordinary-returns test reads the filer's and the rivals' filings; with no rival named in eight reports, the filer's own nine years were judged alone (a stricter reading sends the name to TOO HARD (WORK)), the same gap JCSE raised; (2) the text does not say on which capital "ordinary" is judged: the company's ROCE with acquisition goodwill (never above 9.7%) or Q3's capital actually needed (17% to 19% pre-tax on adjusted EBIT in the two best years); (3) Q7's net debt ("borrowings and finance leases") has no rule for a captive leasing business whose funding and interest already sit in operating cash flow; the choice moves fair from about EUR 9 to below zero; (4) a part's own return on capital is often not disclosed, and the text does not say whether the group figure may stand in for the deciding part. The analyst could not get any rival's filing, the 2020 report in English, the remuneration report, or a complete list of releases after 2026-07-30 (the quote fell from about EUR 45 to 33.85 since September, unexplained).
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: the German forklift and warehouse-truck maker (with service, rental and a captive leasing arm, 83% of five-year segment profit; Dematic warehouse automation does not decide), EMEA unit leader and world number two, whose castle stands but has protected only ordinary returns: group ROCE never above 9.7% pre-tax over 2017-2025, owner cash about 5% of tangible capital, global unit share 15.0% to about 13%, and the filer's own risk report naming rivals with cost advantages; no rival named in eight annual reports, so none compared. Q1 IN. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range EUR 7.01 to 67.26 a share against EUR 33.85, no case earning the floor; fair EUR 9.10 all-equity (EUR 16.09 equity-only), not armed. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: Weichai Power holds 46.5%; shares issued at EUR 64.83 and 62.04; a 2026 free-cash-flow redefinition worth EUR 494.7M in the half.
